The coordinator closes docs/readiness/2026-09-06-slurp-evo-s1-slot-schema-evolution-v1-preregistration.md first (the reward metric, the read option, the fold-quota power ruling), and the nine prerequisites of that document's section 13 must land before any cell here is launched -- in particular the two fold dataset fragments, their probe-sample views, their D1 media supplements and their packet promotions, none of which exists yet, and the one-time closed-list intent flight whose sealed manifests every cell below binds as its predecessor. Every 'PENDING' value is filled by the per-round fragment emitter when that round is assembled.
purpose: Cell EVO-S1 of the 2026-09-05 three-dimension experiment program (sections 4c and 5), the generality rung of the system-evolution dimension and, by the owner directive of 2026-09-06, its PRIMARY demonstration: the same loop code and the same selection rule as EVO-A1, on SLURP, evolving the per-intent TRAIN slot schema KC-S1b admitted. This fragment carries only the speech-bearing REWARD flights, which are baseline-reproduction. The proposer's own text contacts are bounded-discovery-probe and need a SECOND fragment (configs/experiment/slurp-evo-s1-proposer-v1.json), because a composed experiment fragment declares exactly one execution_plan and therefore exactly one execution profile.
hypothesis: H1: shown only its own incumbent block and eight construction utterances of a scenario with their gold entities, the frozen core can rewrite the per-intent slot schema so that per-row strict entity F1 rises on rows it has never seen, and a best-of-K selection over four rounds produces a schema whose gain survives one read on DEV against the SEALED KC-S1b rows. H2: the shares-only control (the incumbent blocks with every filler list deleted) is the content floor, and the token-matched form twin is the form floor. Both controls are deterministic and cost no contact.

predecessor.verdict: ADMITTED on both preregistered conditions. SLU-F1 44.35 against the sealed closed-list direct baseline's 35.80 (+8.55), paired NEW500 slot F1 +10.11 pp CI90 [+8.11, +12.19], and +10.02 pp CI90 [+8.01, +12.10] against the equal-contact control KC-S1a. Its artifact is this cell's A_0 and its sealed rows are this cell's headline comparator.

full_rendering.role: the fallback block, sent when the sealed closed-list response does not parse or names a (scenario, action) pair TRAIN never carries -- 42 of 1,000 rows on DEV-1000

a_0.reproduced: re-mined from TRAIN and reproduced to the content hash by SAEA-SLURP-MF-EVO-CONSTRUCTION-CAPACITY-V1 before a number was counted

state.candidate_state: per intent, ONLY (a) which entity types to list and in what order and (b) up to five fillers per listed type. The header line and every share are re-rendered by the renderer from the unfloored TRAIN table, so a candidate can never write a number. The block grammar, the intent-selection rule, the fallback, the system message, the contact count and the roster are all unchanged from KC-S1b.
state.form: token delta against the incumbent block is REPORTED per candidate; the search budget is +20 percent tokens over the incumbent block per intent, measured through the flight tokenizer (never an estimator). ASCII only; at most five fillers per type; at most L type lines per intent where L is that intent's unfloored TRAIN type count; every listed type has at least one TRAIN mention for that intent; the header byte-identical to A_0's.

targets.definition: a target is a SLURP scenario; there are eighteen and they are disjoint by construction (one gold scenario per utterance, one scenario per intent, so no two targets write into the same block)
targets.least_addressable: music (71.7 percent of its TRAIN utterances carry no entity; KC-S1b moved it 0.0 pp) and audio (80.3 percent; +3.3 pp). Named before takeoff so a null on them is not read afterwards as a loop failure.

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: ROUND 1, FOLD A: 6 arms (the incumbent plus K_1 = 5 portfolios) x 540 rows = 3,240. Budgets are cumulative across every attempt of a run id, so the registered ceiling for SAEA-SLURP-EVO-S1-FOLD-A-V1 is R_max x this = 12,960. Fold B is 2 arms x 540 = 1,080 per round, ceiling 4,320 on its own run id.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 6 x fold A's own pass duration; the fold-A ceiling is R_max x that.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 3,240 calls x 0.75 s per call = 0.68 h; 0.8 planned. 0.75 s per call is what KC-S1b measured at -np 4 (1,000 contacts in 735.9 s).
execution_plan_basis.whole_cell: 17,956 contacts (read Option B) or 19,456 (Option A) across five or six run ids; about 4.9 to 5.2 GPU-h. That is roughly twice the program's own estimate for this cell ('about 10,000, under 1.0'), which was written before the fold size was fixed at 540. Section 10 of the preregistration carries the table and section 16 the remedies.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are each exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, and the budget is cumulative across every attempt of a run id.

evaluation.reward_metric: per-row slot_f1_exact_f1 (strict entity F1, exact type+filler match) -- the metric KC-S1b was admitted on, the least gameable of the per-row metrics, and not a term in the official SLU-F1's own arithmetic
evaluation.read_metric: the official corpus SLU-F1 from the unmodified evaluate.py at pinned commit 8eb16545762be97ace75334109d73824217311f1 -- the READ metric, never the reward
evaluation.stage_one: rails.evolution.select_per_target on fold A, per scenario, gates saves >= 4 / harms <= 1 / net >= 3 on that scenario's own 30 rows, winner = largest net then fewer harms then fewer artifact bytes then lowest k. A COUNT rule: at 30 rows an interval says nothing. SEE preregistration section 16 open point 1 -- at 30 rows this gate is thin and the arithmetic is stated before takeoff
evaluation.stage_two: rails.evolution.confirm_assembly on fold B, with the background bound REPLACED by a per-scenario harm bound (no background population exists when every scenario is a target): the pooled 540-row CI90 lower bound strictly above 0 AND no scenario's own 30-row point estimate below -1.0 pp. Accepted as a whole, never partially
evaluation.intervals: analysis.paired.paired_contrast, 10,000 replicates stratified by scenario, seed 20260903, CI90, exact sign test
evaluation.per_round_receipt: rails.evolution.write_round_receipt under docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-06-slurp-evo-s1/; replay_selection must reproduce every stage-one decision from the sealed per-sample score files alone
mandatory_slices: the evolution curve: round versus fold-A gain, fold-B gain and curve gain
the final paired delta against the SEALED KC-S1b rows and against the sealed closed-list direct rows, per scenario, with the published brackets beside the corpus row
the generalization gap G = delta_foldB - delta_read and the transfer ratio delta_read / delta_foldB
the proposer minus the shares-only control, and the proposer minus the token-matched form twin, on the same rows
the per-entity-type strict table before and after
the fallback-row count per read (42 of 1,000 on DEV-1000 for KC-S1b)
per candidate: six-gram decontamination verdict, exemplar overlap count, per-intent token delta, per-intent line and character counts

decision.primary: the final read's paired per-row slot F1 delta against the SEALED KC-S1b rows on the decision population
decision.admitted: ADMITTED: the read's CI90 lower bound over sealed KC-S1b is above 0, both weightings agree in sign, and the generalization gap is at most half the construction gain
decision.null: NULL: the curve rose but the read's CI includes 0 (reported as overfitting, with the selection rule named), or the curve never rose
decision.harmful: HARMFUL: the read's upper bound is below 0; the schema branch ends with its form/content attribution recorded
kill_results: no scenario admitted in rounds 1 and 2
a construction gain of at least 2 pp whose read CI90 includes 0, or a transfer ratio below 0.25
the shares-only control within 0.5 pp of the proposer
the token-matched form twin indistinguishable from the proposer candidate
every candidate failing the per-scenario harm bound
decision.stop_rule: R_max = 4; stop after two consecutive rejects or an accepted gain under 0.5 pp (rails.evolution.should_stop)
decision.claim_surface: rung 1 only. The folds are construction-role discovery rows drawn from TRAIN and disjoint from every identity this study has ever contacted; the read rows are DEV identities already contacted three times.
decision.not_authorized: no test contact, no fresh roster, no DEV-500-B opening, no Q8_0, no second answering model, no parameter update, no edit to an artifact after its fragment was emitted. At most one recovery re-registration per run id.
